::: proof

#### Shorter proof

For any random variable $Z$ with $\E{Z^2} < \infty$,
the [simplified expression for variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#thm-variance)
rearranges to $\E{Z^2} = \var{Z} + \sqf{\E{Z}}$.
Apply it to the [estimation error](#def-estimation-error) $Z = \erf{\hparam}$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\pMSE{\hparam}
&= \E{\sqf{\erf{\hparam}}}
&& \text{(definition of pMSE)}\\
&= \var{\erf{\hparam}} + \sqf{\E{\erf{\hparam}}}
&& \text{(second moment is variance plus squared mean)}\\
&= \var{\erf{\hparam}} + \sqf{\bias{\hparam}}
&& \text{(definition of bias)}\\
&= \var{\hparam - \param} + \sqf{\bias{\hparam}}
&& \text{(definition of estimation error)}\\
&= \var{\hparam} + \sqf{\bias{\hparam}}
&& \text{(subtracting a constant does not change a variance)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Unlike the [expansion route](#thm-mse-expand),
this proof never expands the square.

Source: @wikipedia_mean_squared_error.

:::
